name: Ethiopia
summary: Horn of Africa highland nation and water tower of East Africa. Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam (GERD) on the Blue Nile anchors an entirely renewable national electricity grid.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 6.52x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); domestic biomass cooking fuels combined with vehicle exhaust in high-altitude Addis Ababa.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; acute drought in Somali and Oromia lowlands during consecutive failed rainy seasons.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Linear warming trend across Ethiopian highland and Rift Valley stations over 1994-2023.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 0.05% share of global fossil emissions; transport sector dominates fossil combustion.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: One of the world's lowest per capita rates; 99% renewable power prevents power sector emissions.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Highland montane forests covering ~151,000 km²; Green Legacy initiative planted billions of tree seedlings.

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Near-total zero-carbon grid: GERD, Gilgel Gibe, and Beles hydropower dams generate 96.5% alongside wind.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 127 people/km²; rural agrarian population fraction is 77.2%.
